Deterministic evidence: success — the only gate attempted was `diff_stat` (exit 0), consistent with the docs-only scope; no test run is disclosed in the PR body and is appropriate here.

All 37 pages of the full immutable diff were read and assessed. Source claims were re-verified against the working tree (narrowing accrual/threshold and the commitment system's stale-binding read with no overlap recheck, pacing's dt floor and enlarge-only time slip, advance-simulation-clock's consume-then-install order, kinematics euler-advance/frame-offset/absorb order, SoA and influence-registry channel lists, flight presets and retention ranges), and the design/research arithmetic (binding folds, residence and ceiling tables, recurrence roots, worked examples, counterexamples) was recomputed by hand — all match. Confirmed findings (non-blocking): 1 — low-severity contract: `docs/research/physics/2026-10-07-pre-capture-clock-envelope.md:19` cites `advance-simulation-clock` at "lines 175–204", but the function spans 178–207 at head and line 206 (the `:sim/dt` install the sentence describes) falls outside the cited window; the sibling doc in this same PR anchors the same function correctly at #L178-L216, so the anchors disagree. Fix: update the prose range.

Rejected after adversarial validation: two wording nits in the same envelope doc ("too restrictive" for a step that exceeds the 0.1-AU ceiling, and a single-fold reading of "meaningful fraction" of one AU) — both rejected because the substance is arithmetically correct and the doc's own adjacent tables make the intended meaning unambiguous.

Non-blocking notes: no tests run (disclosed, docs-only); the INDEX "Last updated" line mentions only one of the three notebooks this PR adds; the spec card file lacks a trailing newline. Proposals are consistently labeled proposed/incoming/unverified — no overclaimed guarantees found.
